verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਵਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਵਨੀ ਸਹੇਤ ਸਕਲ ਸਪੂਤੀ ਏਕ ਬਾਂਝ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise raajaa ravat anek ravanee sahet sakal sapootee ek baa(n)jh na sa(n)taan hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a king loves many queens who all bear him a son, but there may be one who is barren, who cannot bear any issue.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੀਚਤ ਸਲਿਲ ਜੈਸੇ ਸਫਲ ਸਕਲ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸੇਂਬਲ ਸਲਿਲ ਨਿਰਬਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: seechat salil jaise safal sakal dhrum nihafal se(n)bal salil nirabaan hai ||

en.bdb: Just as irrigating the trees help them bear fruits but the cotton silk tree remains fruitless. It does not accept the influence of water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਦਰ ਕਮਲ ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਸਰਵਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਉਤਮ ਅਉ ਨੀਚ ਕੀਚ ਦਿਨਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhaadhar kamal jaise ek saravar bikhai utam aau neech keech dhinakar dhiaan hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a frog and a lotus flower live in one pond but lotus is supreme since it faces Sun and frog is low since it remains engrossed in mud.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਹੈ ਸਕਲ ਜਗੁ ਚੰਦਨ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਬਾਂਸ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥੫੧੯॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur charan saran hai sakal jag cha(n)dhan banaasapatee baa(n)s unamaan hai ||519||

en.bdb: Similarly the whole world comes into the refuge of the True Guru. Devoted Sikhs who obtain the elixir-like Naam from the True Guru become fragrant but a bamboo-like arrogant person remains without the fragrance. (519)
